Settings and safety

Privacy, blocking and reporting, alerts, light and dark, going away, leaving, getting your account back, and checking your 12 words as an owner.

  • Your privacyWhat others can see about you, and the settings that control it.
  • Blocking someoneHide someone's posts and messages from you, and undo it later.
  • Reporting a problemTell your community's moderators about a post, an event, a Pulse post or an enterprise.
  • NotificationsChoose which alerts reach your phone, and when events remind you.
  • Light and darkThe app starts light. Make it dark, or follow your phone.
  • Going awayHoliday Mode hides your Offers and pauses new requests while you are away.
  • Leaving or deleting your accountSign out of this phone, or delete your account for good, and what happens to your beans.
  • Getting your account backRestore your account on a new phone, and protect it with a sign-in account.
  • Your 12 words and the server's keys (owners)For a community's owners. Checking your 12 words, taking over or restoring the server with your phone, and the check your phone makes by itself.

The same guide is in the BeanPool app, and works there without a connection: open Settings, then "Help & how it works" under BeanPool. Every other rule, guide and manual is in the Help Centre. Guide version 39.
